name: Classroom Emergency Response Protocols and Safety Posters
description: Each classroom keeps a copy of its building emergency response protocols, and age-appropriate safety posters are displayed throughout each school.
recipient: Students and staff in each classroom / school
quote: Each classroom in the District shall have a copy of the emergency response protocols relevant to their school building. Age-appropriate safety posters shall also be displayed throughout each school building outlining the appropriate response(s) to a variety of emergency situations that could arise in the school setting.
